facts: The same non-Clone PreparedHostAuthoritySession is consumed and returned inside the original PreparedRootHostInitialGenerationV1.
Fresh and Recover have separate public methods and exact tagged protected input purposes. There is no automatic Fresh fallback.
The existing 64 KiB Root0600/no-follow/private-parent JSON reader remains unchanged. All public record DTOs reject unknown fields; original constructors verify signatures and complete bindings.
Five distinct retained Root0600 regular single-link descriptors have fixed read-only or read-write access. No file is opened from a caller-selected peer request.

Existing Artifact state and all six original child directories plus owner.lock are required. required_current_head is mandatory; the original owner verifies full trust, writer lease, withdrawal history, head and storage binding.
The withdrawal registry is loaded through read_dataset_withdrawal_snapshot with its complete receipt. No empty registry or replacement history is constructed.
The original independent selection verifier and SelectedGeneration::load consume real registry/payload files. Decoded records are not opaque VerifiedSelection values.

FinalUse requires existing authority.lock, authority.json schema3 and authority.claims beneath the same Root state. Original existing frontier open and exact original local nonce replay remain mandatory.
The complete protected external frontier is compared before and after original FinalUse loading; the original issuer head is unchanged. No head update, genesis or nonce refund exists.

Consumer owner_id is explicit but must equal retained issuer trust_key.key_id for both supported trust models; Fresh signed.grant.signer_id must match too. This follows actual issuer9e498 full-grant verification and FinalUse84d55 claim, not a fixture convention.

SingleCurrentIssuer and CurrentIssuerKeyRing are explicit existing trust formats. The key-ring path supports the actual retained current key only; incompatible preexisting rotation sets refuse, with no trust migration.
Actual target owner-binding digest, task digest, generation and witness bounds are passed unchanged to FileAnchorWitnessStore::open. Recovery refuses empty journal/witness before the original open.
Fresh may write the original header into its explicitly supplied empty witness. Loader failure is not proof of unchanged files; later recovery may also reconcile original journals.

All stages retain one end established at loader entry from the original Session timeout. The loader calls original fixed factories with that same end and does not invoke another deadline-resetting public wrapper.
The original E1 full lease, revoked grant, issuer/head/frontier, same operation, Current and target checks execute when the original bind/recover methods are reached.
No owner getter, new issuer/lease/grant, callback authority, Config/AutomationStore handoff, new actor or same-UID exception is introduced.
remaining: No compiler, formatter, tests, original collector or live owner construction has run.
No deployment configuration, trusted issuer input, independently issued B evidence or actual task success is manufactured.
The ordinary Root CLI, task input files/model factory, same custody Material Source loan and V3 enrollment orchestration are not part of this unit.
No new semantic mechanism tests are included in this first input-loader unit; later tests must use real original owners for positive paths.
Filesystem prechecks do not create a cross-owner atomic transaction; post-open or post-publication refusal retains uncertainty and uses existing recovery.
summary: Existing-owner input loader under the same original Root Session; ordinary CLI and Task/Material/V3 orchestration remain separate unfinished layers.
